cues.what: wry; a sad beat, then a dry laugh (the presser, scored as a tiny bed); playful (the open floor), then lonely (his own face saying it); a chill at the domino and the screws
cues.family: P04 THE CLOCK, first step (quarters), straight; the Door and the GPU choir (MM-18)
motifs: THE CLOCK, first step: a pizzicato and woodblock tick a beat on varied pitches, the chip's irregular seconds
the knee's rising F G A-flat C as held dyads (clarinet, violins)
THE DOOR with its first note missing (flute, through the door)
the GPU choir as the chair's hum (diegetic into score)

C / F pedal: the threshold (on the beat, 0.38 s before the cut): the knee's leap lands on C as the open floor's band lights; the clock carries
the open floor: the cello's pizzicato eighths join (playful: the verbs, the heatsink, the strip)
- / Db pedal: his own reflection mouths "can we talk?" (on the beat, 0.04 s before the cut): THE DOOR blooms, its first note missing; D-flat under it; the ticks soften
THE DOOR blooms once, its first note missing (D-flat C | G held, the #4; no cadence), through the door, on his own reflection mouthing "can we talk?"
C / F pedal: DOT's cuff points at the door (on the beat, 0.25 s before the cut): the F pedal and the C dyad again; the playful pizzicato
- / Db pedal: the chair (on an eighth, 0.23 s before the cut): the pedal to D-flat; the hum is the GPU choir's chord in the room, then the score's (Bukaj, the exchange)

the chair's hum: the GPU choir's chord (D-flat sus2(#11), no third) in the room, low-passed and narrow; over two bars the score's choir opens out of it (diegetic into score; the score plays the claimed chair_hum_choir)
Ek / F pedal: Ekiel (on the beat, 0.21 s before the cut): the F pedal; low spiccato eighths (the chill); the freeze is the SFX's
- / F pedal: Ekiel's post (from 74.85): THE CLOCK thins to its pedal (no tick, no dyad): the record plays dry
- / F pedal: the team's door: the ticks again; the Ache (G + D-flat over the F pedal) for the screws, which take the clock's four ticks themselves
the four screws, one a beat: the clock's own four ticks (the SFX's; the pizzicato and the woodblock leave those beats); the Ache over the F pedal (the chill)
THE CLOCK stops dead on the pivot's creak (the reveal: the door he couldn't open turns on its pin); the hum swells
the cut to the empty office: the hum rings over it (L 1.0 s)
the hum stops where the chair used to be; the felt (E02-09) takes the downbeat

cues.what: loneliness; warmth and joy (the chant, the check-in); gravity (the post, "Someone should."); resolve and dread together (the click, the fire); a determined evening
cues.family: P01 DARK ROOM (one felt piano) -> the Orb-era glossy colour (GPU choir aahs, glass shimmer, ppp) -> felt
motifs: the felt (his interior), one chord a phrase, a top note in the gaps
the GPU choir (D-flat sus2(#11), no third) with glass shimmer; the string lights (celesta, harp)
THE DOOR whole, twice (the check-in; its #4 under the Publish click)
the Ache (F C | G D-flat) under the fire
the knee's leap A-flat C as he goes

sync.what: Dbmaj9: the hum stops where the chair used to be: the felt's first chord on the same downbeat (his interior); D-flat keeps the choir's root
Bbm9: the thread on his phone (on the beat, 0.33 s before the cut): his three hearts, the dates (loneliness); held under the posts and Alyi's far line (unscored)
Fm9: between Alyi's far line and V.O. 7: F minor, struck before the count; nothing attacks under it
Abmaj9: TPOOL (on an eighth, 0.35 s before the cut): the early web's brighter A-flat (P10 T2), the chip on its top: his past
TPOOL: the chip's triangle answers the felt (C, E-flat): his 2006 app still knows him
Gbmaj7#11: "where u at?", every pin LAST SEEN: 2012 (on the beat, 0.38 s before the cut): G-flat lydian, the old map
Dbsus#11: the one warm pin: its ripple; the felt on the choir's chord as the choir swells in under it (the sound lead into F2.2)
the choir swells in under the pin's ripple (the GPU choir, D-flat sus2(#11), ppp): the sound lead into F2.2
F2.2 (on the beat, 0.29 s before the cut): the GPU choir and glass shimmer, ppp; the string lights (celesta, harp) cycling; no felt, no chip pulse, no swing (his POV is left)
the chant's lift (warm, giddy, never a hymn): the choir adds C and E-flat, the lights climb an octave, the shimmer thickens; no melody on the record (the chant is [V])
the exchange (on the beat, 0.46 s before the cut): the lights stop; the choir thins
THE DOOR, whole, over the choir (his joke check-in; Mas raises his glass): it never cadences, its G held
the racks hum along (on an eighth, 0.31 s before the cut): the choir swells (the racks are the choir); GLYPH's grains on celesta and the 12.5 % chip (the glyph is on the room)
2023 (on the beat, 0.38 s before the cut): the choir thins to its no-third chord under the post and "Someone should."; the cello's D-flat (gravity)
the turn (on the beat, 0.29 s before the cut): the viola and violins join the choir's chord
the Door's held #4 (G) lands 0.61 s before the Publish click (on the beat, 0.21 s before the cut): warm resolve, no cadence; the click is the SFX's
the fire (on the beat, 0.25 s before the cut): the Ache under the choir (F C | G D-flat): the Door's G is the Ache's G; resolve and dread together
the glow shrinks to one point (on an eighth, 0.35 s before the cut): the bass lets go; the choir thins to ppp and holds its no-third chord to the pin (no dropout: the bed stays over -35 LUFS-M)
the pin (on the beat, 0.25 s before the cut): the sul-tasto F pedal swells in over the choir's hold
the felt returns a beat later, soft (F, the open fifth); V.O. 8 inside it, nothing attacks
he goes (on a swung and, 0.29 s before the cut): D-flat; the felt's A-flat, then C on the bar (the knee's leap, the chip under its C): the decision, no F after it
the stairs (on the beat, 0.25 s before the cut): the felt rests; the pedal (F, C) holds through the buzz (the out); it fades under the receipt's chatter (J 1.0 s, SFX) into the band's push

cues.what: the big comic set-piece (scored straight, the stop its only joke); respect; frantic hands under a still face, the relief of hearing him act; a laugh at the forecast (no hit); pathos in the rain; the act-out on a DREAD sting

motifs: the Build's chip lead (compiling 4, 8; whole in octaves with the violins at the peak; the scramble)
brass hits at phrase ends (the full band's shout; the honks take the posts' phrase ends)
one held chord through the night
a pad in the rain, five voices (VOICE 5 stops on the pause)
the DREAD sting (the Ache on the chip, no third)

sync.what: DESIGNED HIT: the swung push into NopeAI's doors (on a swung and, 0.21 s before the cut): the band in; the receipt already pouring (its chatter is the SFX's J)
the Build compiles on the chip (pass 1: 4)
the Build (pass 2: 8), the violins' pizzicato under it
DESIGNED HIT: THE FULL BAND's pickup (on a swung and, 0.25 s before the cut to the run): the receipt down the hill and across five lanes (the episode's one full-band stretch: a pickup and two bars)
the peak: C7(#9b13), the Build in octaves with the violins
DESIGNED HIT: the phrase's last stab (C7(#9b13), the and-of-4); then THE CUT-OFF on the downbeat (the traffic stops; the honk lands in the gap: the SFX's)
the stall: the arco bass holds C (the cello C, the viola G: an open fifth) through the card; the freeze's F is the SFX's, a fourth over it
the Forecaster (on the beat, 0.42 s before the cut): the band again, thin: a two-feel, the ride soft, the vibes; no lead under his terms (respect)
Mas sees it, his phone lit: the bass walks quarters again, the kick feathers in
THE SCRAMBLE (on a swung and, 0.29 s before the cut): the band drops to the bass and the Build's chip lead, busier on the same grid (swung eighths in the bass, the Build's straight 16ths)
his call ("everyone who signed one..."): the Build out, the bass under it (he is heard acting)
the draft: the pedal moves a mediant down (F to D-flat), the Build keeps compiling
V.O. 9 on his still face: the Build out, the bass softer (the frantic inside, no attack on the words)
the Forecaster beside him (on a swung and, 0.17 s before the cut): the swing returns (A-flat), thin under his forecast; no hit on the laugh
his thumb over Post (on a swung and, 0.29 s before the cut): the band thins to a held E-flat 9sus (strings, the arco bass); V.O. 10 inside it
the night (on a swung and, 0.29 s before the cut): one held chord, D-flat maj9 (the strings, the bowed vibes), the bridge's lights cycling once
the next afternoon (on the beat, 0.21 s before the cut): the bass pedal (F, C) under his posts (the record dry); the honks take the phrase ends; "Updating." and the driver play over it, no hit
the pad: Dbmaj9: May 20: the pad in the rain (the thunder is tuned to F: the pad's F4)
the pad: Bbm9: the ink runs
the chip, once, in the rain: the Build's tag (C F), small and far ("shipped", no longer)
the pad: Gbmaj7#11: the voice menu: his thumb finds VOICE 5
his thumb taps Pause: VOICE 5 (the pad's fifth voice, the bowed vibes) stops; four voices hold (no hit, no notification)
NopeAI's post (two fragments): the pad holds, no change (the record dry)
the pad: Fped: the blimp sags: the pad thins to its pedal (F, C)
